introH2: 🏯 What kind of stays does the Old City have, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: The Old City of Chiang Mai is a square of walls and a moat more than 700 years old, packed inside with Lanna temples, craft shops, cafes and markets — the biggest draw is that you can explore the whole quarter on foot, barely needing to call a car. Wake up and stroll to Wat Phra Singh, walk on to Wat Chedi Luang, and on Sunday evening the Ratchadamnoen Walking Street is waiting right at your gate · stays in this area are more varied than many people expect, from Lanna teak boutiques and architectural 5-star boutiques to warm homestays and clean hostels for a few hundred baht · one thing to know is that many places are old or small buildings, with limited rooms and soundproofing that often isn't tight, so people who book on pretty photos can end up with a smaller room or hear noise from the lane · this article rounds up 10 stays in the Old City we've reviewed in depth, working down from boutiques to hostels — every one based on reading real guest reviews, giving both the good points and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites with direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Chiang Mai has no metro, but in the Old City you can happily walk to temples and shops all day · to head out of town, calling a Grab or hopping on a red truck (songthaew) is easy and cheap · from Chiang Mai airport (CNX) into the Old City takes about 10–15 min · the main landmarks in the area: Wat Phra Singh and Wat Chedi Luang — big Lanna temples in the middle of town that many of the stays on this list reach in a few minutes on foot · Tha Phae Gate — the eastern city gate, the start of the walking street and the way out to the Night Bazaar · Ratchadamnoen Road — the Sunday Walking Street that runs through the middle of the Old City · Warorot Market (Kad Luang) — a big market by the Ping River for food and northern souvenirs · the Nimman area is about a 10 min drive, and the Night Bazaar about 10 min.

entries.type: Lanna teak boutique · near Wat Phra Singh
entries.name: Baan Boo Loo Village
entries.badge: 🪵 Lanna teak houses in the Old City · highest score
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Intawaroroj · Old City · walk to Wat Phra Singh and the Sunday Walking Street
entries.addr: Soi 3Kor, Intawaroroj 3 Road, Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: If you had to pick the one stay that captures "the Old City of Chiang Mai" in a single place, the honest takes from real reviews lean toward Baan Boo Loo Village · it's a boutique guesthouse of around 10 old teak houses gathered in a green garden down a quiet lane, each built from reclaimed wood pieced back together, so many reviews say it's like sleeping in a genuine Lanna wooden house rather than a room in a block · the location is inside the city walls near Wat Phra Singh, within walking distance of the Sunday Walking Street · what people mention most often is the breakfast, a standout meal of the trip, plus Thai cooking classes, a garden pool and a spa to relax in · with a 9.6 from 1,262 reviews, this is number one on the list for anyone who wants a real Lanna atmosphere in the middle of the Old City.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you're sensitive to noise, ask for a house deep inside the village at the time of booking, since some houses near the lane entrance can pick up sound from outside · the entrance lane is fairly small, so if you're driving, pin the location carefully and call ahead about parking · and don't miss the breakfast, which many people rate the meal of the trip.
pros: Lanna teak houses set as private houses in a garden, a real Old City atmosphere
Location inside the city walls near Wat Phra Singh, walk to the Sunday Walking Street
Breakfast praised as delicious · Thai cooking classes, a garden pool and a spa
Score of 9.6, the highest on the list, with warm family-style service (from the reviews)
cons: Small old wooden houses, and some near the lane entrance pick up outside noise
No lift or the full facilities of a big chain hotel
The entrance lane is small, tricky for larger cars, and easy to miss the first time

entries.type: Boutique 5★ · next to Wat Chedi Luang
entries.name: Chala Number 6
entries.badge: 🛕 next to Wat Chedi Luang · garden pool
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Prapokklao Road · under 3 min walk to Wat Chedi Luang
entries.addr: 6/6 Prapokklao Road, Phra Sing, Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Chala Number 6 is the answer for people who want both a central Old City location and a private, resort-like feel in one place · it's a 5-star boutique hotel on Prapokklao Road, under a 3 min walk to Wat Chedi Luang and Wat Phan Tao, with the Sunday Walking Street right around the corner, yet back in the room it's as quiet as a resort outside town · it opened in 2017 and was renovated in 2023 · what reviews agree on is the spacious suites starting at 55 sqm, decorated in bright, contemporary Thai tones, many opening onto the garden, with comfortable, very clean beds · there's a pool set in the garden, a poolside bar and free afternoon tea in the rice barn, with warm, thoughtful service · it suits couples and families who want a luxurious stay in the Old City at a price that's still within reach.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: rooms without a balcony have small windows and less light, so if you love natural light, request a room with a balcony or a garden door when booking · soundproofing isn't very tight, so if you're sensitive to noise, ask for a room set back from the main corridor · during Yi Peng/Loy Krathong the hotel fills fast, so book several weeks ahead.
pros: Location next to Wat Chedi Luang, under a 3 min walk, with the walking street around the corner
Spacious suites from 55 sqm, very clean, many opening onto the garden
Garden pool, poolside bar and free afternoon tea
Warm, praised service, renovated in 2023 (from the reviews)
cons: Soundproofing between rooms still isn't good enough, you may hear next door or the corridor
Rooms without a balcony have small windows and less light, worth requesting when booking
In high season and during festivals prices climb high and rooms fill very fast

entries.type: Boutique hotel · Chang Moi, near Tha Phae Gate
entries.name: My Chiangmai Boutique Lodge
entries.revCount: Booking 9.1 · over 2,000 reviews · from real reviews
entries.badge: 💙 great value with a pool · excellent service
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chang Moi · 12 min walk to Tha Phae Gate, near Warorot Market
entries.addr: 425/1 Witchayanon Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: My Chiangmai Boutique Lodge is a small boutique of just 23 rooms that wins people over on service and value more than luxury · tucked down a quiet lane in the Chang Moi area, it's under a fifteen-minute walk to Tha Phae Gate and the old city walls, near Warorot Market, the Night Bazaar and the Sunday Walking Street · what reviews praise most is staff who look after you like a Chiang Mai friend, helping arrange tours, book airport cars and recommend local restaurants · there's an outdoor pool with a separate kids' pool, a poolside bar, free parking and a lovely breakfast, with an overall 9.1 from over 2,000 reviews, starting around ฿1,400/night · it's a great fit for anyone with a budget of around one to two thousand baht who wants a stay with a pool near the Old City.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the common areas and pool are open near the garden, so there are some mosquitoes in the evening — bring repellent and swim during the day · the hotel doesn't serve dinner, so plan to eat in the Old City within walking distance · and with only 23 rooms, book 1–2 months ahead in high season.
pros: The most praised service, staff who arrange tours and give tips like a friend
A pool, poolside bar and free parking in the low-thousand-baht range
Quiet Chang Moi location, yet a 12 min walk to Tha Phae Gate and Warorot Market
Excellent value for a budget of around one to two thousand baht (from the reviews)
cons: A small, simple boutique, no grand lobby or in-house dinner
The pool and garden are open-air, with some mosquitoes in the evening — bring repellent
No lift · only 23 rooms, filling fast during festivals

entries.type: Lanna boutique 5★ · beside Wat Phra Singh
entries.name: Rachamankha a Member of Secret Retreats
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rachamankha Road · about 70 m from Wat Phra Singh
entries.addr: 6 Rachamankha 9 Alley, Phra Sing, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Rachamankha is a boutique hotel that many reviews call the most beautiful in the Old City of Chiang Mai in terms of architecture · designed by Ajarn Ood Amatayakul with inspiration from the viharn of Wat Phra That Lampang Luang, you step through the gate to find stone courtyards and quiet cloistered walkways that feel more like an old monastery than a hotel · it opened in 2004 with just 24 rooms and Lanna suites, set on Rachamankha Road about 70 m from Wat Phra Singh, within walking distance of Wat Chedi Luang and Tha Phae Gate · there's a praised northern-Thai restaurant in the courtyard, a serene outdoor pool, a Lanna herbal spa and an art library to sit and read in · it's the choice for people ready to pay for the design and top-tier calm more than for value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: this is a top-end price that sells design and atmosphere more than the facilities of a big resort, so if your budget is limited, compare it with mid-range boutiques in the Old City first · the hotel doesn't accept children under 12, so families with young kids should choose elsewhere · with only 24 rooms, it fills very fast during Yi Peng/Loy Krathong, so book several weeks to several months ahead.
pros: Acclaimed classic Lanna architecture, stone courtyards and cloistered walkways
Location beside Wat Phra Singh, walk to Wat Chedi Luang and Tha Phae Gate
Northern-Thai restaurant in the courtyard, a serene pool, a spa and an art library
Top-tier private calm (from the reviews)
cons: Prices are in the highest group on the list, more about atmosphere than value
Some rooms are fairly dark in keeping with the Lanna design
No children under 12 · only 24 rooms, filling fast

entries.type: Boutique B&B · moat edge, Chang Phuak Gate
entries.name: Si Phum Heritage Boutique Bed & Breakfast
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Manee Nopparat Road · moat edge by Chang Phuak Gate
tags: 🏯 next to the Old City moat
entries.addr: 14/34 Manee Nopparat Road, Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Si Phum Heritage Boutique Bed & Breakfast is a small B&B of around 11 rooms on Manee Nopparat Road, sitting right on the edge of the Old City moat by Chang Phuak Gate · open the door and you find wooden furniture, vintage lamps and European-meets-Lanna collectibles lined up like a museum you can actually sleep in, every corner photogenic · cross the road and you're at the city wall, a few minutes' walk to Wat Chiang Man and the morning market · the real highlight is the vintage atmosphere full of character and staff who look after guests closely enough to earn the highest praise for service · starting around ฿900/night, it suits people who value an Old City location and a charming atmosphere at a budget price more than the facilities of a big hotel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the walls are fairly thin and the road out front has passing traffic, so if you sleep lightly, ask for an inner room that doesn't face the street and say you want a quiet room · it's an old house with no lift, so if you have heavy luggage, ask for a ground-floor room when booking · and check with the property about breakfast before booking, since details can change.
pros: European-meets-Lanna vintage decor with character, every corner photogenic
Next to the Old City moat by Chang Phuak Gate, cross the road to the wall and temples
Warm, family-like service, the highest praise for staff
From ฿900/night, great value for an Old City location (from the reviews)
cons: Thin walls and road noise out front, worth asking for an inner room
An old house with no lift, and some beds are fairly firm
No pool or gym · check breakfast with the property before booking

entries.name: Stamps Backpackers
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.6 · over 5,000 reviews · from real reviews
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chaiyapoom Road · a few minutes' walk to Tha Phae Gate and the walking street
entries.addr: 1/11 Chaiyapoom Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Stamps Backpackers is a social hostel that won Best Social Hostel in Asia at the Hoscars two years running · every night there are activities that turn strangers into travel friends — quiz night, music bingo, BBQ and pub crawl · what reviews mention most is staff who go above and beyond and an atmosphere that keeps solo travellers from feeling lonely · the beds are pods with a privacy curtain, a reading light, twin sockets and a big locker, with both fan and air-con dorms, starting around ฿450/night · the location is on Chaiyapoom Road, a few minutes' walk to Tha Phae Gate, Wat Chiang Man and the Sunday Walking Street · it's the best fit for travellers aged 18–35 travelling solo who want to meet new people in the middle of the Old City.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: sound from the ground-floor bar drifts up to the rooms in the early evening despite a quiet rule after 11pm, so if you sleep lightly, ask for a bed in a dorm far from the bar and pack earplugs · these are shared pod dorms with shared bathrooms that sometimes have a queue, so anyone wanting a private room should look elsewhere · and it only accepts guests aged 18–35.
pros: Best Social Hostel in Asia, with activities every night, easy to meet people
Staff who go above and beyond, solo travellers don't feel lonely
Pod beds with a privacy curtain, light, socket and a big locker, comfier than expected
Central Old City location, walk to Tha Phae Gate and the walking street · from ฿450
cons: Fairly loud in the early evening as bar noise drifts up to the rooms
Only accepts ages 18–35, not ideal for families or anyone wanting quiet
Shared pod dorms with shared bathrooms that sometimes queue · the building is starting to age

entries.name: Live n' Leaf Lifestyle Homestay and Café
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Samlarn Road · walk to Wat Phra Singh and the Sunday Walking Street
entries.addr: 100 Samlarn Road, Phra Sing, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Live n' Leaf Lifestyle Homestay and Café is a small homestay of just 5 rooms that many reviews say feels more like staying at a friend's house than a hotel · it's a white house trimmed with green leaf motifs, with a cafe on the ground floor, set on Samlarn Road inside the old city walls, a few minutes' walk to Wat Phra Singh, Wat Sri Suphan and the Sunday Walking Street · each room is decorated in a different green-and-white leaf theme, with air-con and an en-suite bathroom, clean and pretty enough to earn a perfect cleanliness score · the highlight is the local breakfast cooked fresh from the cafe and friendly staff who help above and beyond · starting around ฿800/night, it suits people who want a central Old City location, a pretty private room and warmth at an affordable price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: rooms facing the road pick up car and motorbike noise, so if you're sensitive to sound, ask for a quieter inner room when booking · there's no lift and the rooms are upstairs, so if you have heavy bags, ask the staff for help · with only 5 rooms, book ahead, especially during festivals.
pros: A warm homestay like staying at a friend's, with staff who help above and beyond
5 rooms in different leaf themes, clean and pretty with a perfect cleanliness score
Central Old City location, walk to Wat Phra Singh and the Sunday Walking Street
A cafe and fresh local breakfast · from ฿800/night (from the reviews)
cons: Road-facing rooms are disturbed by car and motorbike noise
A small 5-room homestay, no pool, no lift, rooms upstairs
Not many reviews yet (around 15) · not ideal for large families needing spacious rooms

entries.type: Boutique inn · near Tha Phae Gate and the Night Bazaar
entries.name: The Old City Wall Inn
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sridonchai Road · walk to Tha Phae Gate and the Night Bazaar
entries.addr: 35/7-12 Sridonchai Road, Chang Khlan, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: The Old City Wall Inn is a small inn of just 14 rooms on Sridonchai Road that many people choose for an Old City location at an easy-on-the-wallet price · it's a few minutes' walk to Tha Phae Gate, the Night Bazaar, Anusarn Market and the walking street, so you barely need to call a car · it opened in 2017, and what reviews agree on is staff who are genuinely warm and helpful and rooms that are clean, scoring high at around 9.4 · there's an in-house Thai massage and body-scrub spa to unwind after a day out, plus free parking, starting around ฿700/night · it suits people who want a central location on the Tha Phae side, warm staff and clean rooms at a lighter price than a big hotel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: rooms on the Sridonchai Road side pick up traffic noise, and the windows and doors are fairly thin, so if you don't sleep soundly, ask for a Garden View or inner room when booking and pack earplugs just in case · it's a small inn with no pool, so anyone who needs one should look at a bigger hotel · with around 14 rooms it fills fast during festivals, so book ahead.
pros: Central location on the Tha Phae side, walk to Tha Phae Gate and the Night Bazaar
Genuinely warm, helpful staff and clean rooms scoring high at around 9.4
An in-house Thai massage spa and free parking
From ฿700/night, lighter than a big hotel (from the reviews)
cons: Road-side rooms pick up traffic noise, with fairly thin windows and doors
No pool or gym, it's a small inn
Housekeeping is sometimes inconsistent · around 14 rooms, filling fast

entries.name: Green Sleep Hostel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ratchadamnoen Soi 7 · walk to Wat Phra Singh and Wat Chedi Luang
entries.addr: 5/10 Soi 7, Ratchadamnoen Road, Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: Green Sleep Hostel is a small hostel down a quiet lane in the Old City that real reviews mention for three things over and over: clean, quiet and warm staff · many people say it's the cleanest hostel they've ever stayed in, rooms, bathrooms and shared kitchen alike, boutique-level clean at a hostel price · it's on Soi 7 off Ratchadamnoen Road, within walking distance of Wat Phra Singh, Wat Chedi Luang, the Three Kings Monument and the Sunday Walking Street · dorm beds have a privacy curtain, a reading light, a socket and a locker, with both mixed and female-only dorms, and an all-female staff team that's friendly, helps book tours and remembers guests · starting around ฿300/night, the lightest budget on the list, it suits people who want a clean, quiet stay in the middle of the Old City for a few hundred baht.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the beds here are fairly firm and some rooms are near the shared bathrooms where you may hear noise late at night, so if you sleep lightly, ask for a bed or room away from the bathrooms and pack earplugs · some rooms have no window, so if you want natural light, pick a room type that specifies a window when booking · this is a calm, clean place, not a party hostel.
pros: Reviews rank cleanliness as the number-one highlight, boutique-level clean at a hostel price
Central Old City location, walk to Wat Phra Singh, Wat Chedi Luang and the walking street
Dorm beds with a privacy curtain, light, socket and locker · a female-only dorm
Warm all-female staff who look after you like home · from ฿300, lightest budget
cons: Beds are fairly firm, and some rooms near the shared bathrooms hear noise late at night
Some rooms have no window, with little natural light
No pool or spa · a calm place, not a social hostel

entries.name: HOSTEL by BED (The Common Hostel)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Singharat Road · about 500 m to the Sunday Walking Street
entries.addr: 54/2-4 Singharat Road, Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai
entries.storyHtml: HOSTEL by BED (now going by The Common Hostel) is a hostel that looks more like a boutique cafe than a travellers' dorm, with polished-concrete floors, warm lighting and a quiet reading nook · what reviews mention most is the cleanliness, the quiet and staff who are kind and genuine, a fit for people who want a dorm's low price without trading it for chaos and grime · it's on Singharat Road in the Old City, about 500 m to the Sunday Walking Street, near Wat Phra Singh, Wat Chedi Luang and Tha Phae Gate · every dorm bed has a closing curtain, a reading light, a socket and a locker, with a female-only dorm, a queen bed in a dorm, and private rooms with an en-suite bathroom · starting around ฿380/night, it suits solo travellers, budget couples and digital nomads who want a clean, quiet stay with some design.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: this place is about quiet and cleanliness more than buzz, with no drinking activities or pub crawl, so if you want a social vibe, try Stamps Backpackers instead · the Wi-Fi is sometimes unstable, especially in the deeper rooms, so digital nomads should keep a mobile data plan as backup and work in the common areas · it only accepts guests aged 18 and up, and the building has no lift.
pros: A design hostel in polished-concrete and wood tones, quiet and clean, good for resting
Every bed has a privacy curtain, light, socket and locker · private rooms with en-suite bathrooms
Central Old City location, walk to the walking street, Wat Phra Singh and Tha Phae Gate
Kind, genuine staff · from ฿380/night (from the reviews)
cons: Focused on quiet, not a party hostel, with no nightly activities
The Wi-Fi is sometimes unstable, especially in the deeper rooms
Only accepts ages 18 and up · the building has no lift

advice.head: Want to stay next to a temple and walk the Old City all day
advice.bodyHtml: → Chala Number 6 ฿3,500, a 5-star boutique under a 3 min walk to Wat Chedi Luang with a garden pool · or Green Sleep Hostel ฿300, a clean hostel within walking distance of Wat Phra Singh and Wat Chedi Luang

noteHtml: 📌 Note: all prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room range and may change by date and season — we recommend checking real prices and comparing 3 sites before every booking · the scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms · many stays in the Old City are old or small buildings where soundproofing often isn't tight, so if you're a light sleeper we suggest asking for an inner room or a quieter floor and bringing earplugs · during festivals (Yi Peng/Loy Krathong in Nov, Songkran 13–15 Apr, New Year) prices rise and rooms fill fast, so book 1–2 months ahead · Chiang Mai has no metro; the Old City is walkable, and a Grab or red truck is easy for heading out of town, with the airport about 10–15 min from the Old City · article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travellers often ask about staying in the Old City, Chiang Mai

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best stay in the Old City of Chiang Mai?
faq.a: It depends on your budget and style · if you want a real Lanna atmosphere in the middle of the Old City, Baan Boo Loo Village, teak houses scoring 9.6 · if you want a luxurious stay next to a temple, Chala Number 6, a 5-star boutique next to Wat Chedi Luang · on a low-thousand-baht budget with a pool, My Chiangmai Boutique Lodge ฿1,400 · on a few-hundred-baht budget, Green Sleep Hostel ฿300 or Stamps Backpackers ฿450, score 9.6

faq.q: ❓ How much do Old City stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at around ฿300–8,500 per night · on the light-budget side, Green Sleep Hostel from ฿300, HOSTEL by BED ฿380 and Stamps Backpackers ฿450 (dorm) · mid-range is Old City Wall Inn ฿700, Live n' Leaf ฿800, Si Phum Heritage ฿900 and My Chiangmai ฿1,400 · on the boutique side, Baan Boo Loo ฿3,200, Chala ฿3,500 and Rachamankha ฿8,500 · all prices are approximate starting rates from standard rooms, and may be higher during festivals

faq.q: ❓ Can you really walk to the temples and the walking street from Old City stays?
faq.a: Yes, from almost every one in this article · the biggest draw of this area is that you can explore the whole quarter on foot, barely needing to call a car · Baan Boo Loo, Rachamankha and Green Sleep are within walking distance of Wat Phra Singh · Chala is under a 3 min walk to Wat Chedi Luang · Stamps and the Old City Wall Inn are within walking distance of Tha Phae Gate · on Sunday evening the Ratchadamnoen Walking Street runs through the middle of the Old City, reachable on foot from most of these stays

faq.q: ❓ Are Old City stays noisy · what kind of room should I ask for?
faq.a: Many stays in this area are old or small buildings where soundproofing often isn't tight, and some sit on roads with passing traffic · many on the list have reviews agreeing that you may hear noise from the lane, next door or the road · if you're a light sleeper, we recommend asking for an inner room that doesn't face the street, or a house/floor set deeper in at the time of booking, and bringing earplugs · a social hostel like Stamps is lively in the early evening, so if you want quiet, choose Green Sleep or HOSTEL by BED instead

faq.q: ❓ Which Old City stays suit families and couples?
faq.a: Families: Chala Number 6 has Family Rooms and a garden pool · My Chiangmai has a separate kids' pool and help arranging tours · Baan Boo Loo has the Mango Villa and Mountain View Lodge houses for larger groups · Couples: Rachamankha focuses on a grown-up, design-led atmosphere (no children under 12) · Si Phum Heritage, a warm vintage house · note that Stamps and HOSTEL by BED are adults-only, not suited to young children

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book an Old City stay?
faq.a: Many stays in this article are small boutiques or homestays (5–24 rooms), so they fill fast · during high season (November–February) and the Yi Peng/Loy Krathong festival, book 1–2 months ahead, especially Rachamankha, Chala, Baan Boo Loo and Live n' Leaf, which have few rooms · at other times 3–4 weeks is enough · every platform offers Free Cancellation, so we recommend locking in a rate that way if your plans aren't fixed, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price

quickAnswerHtml: The Old City of Chiang Mai has stays for every budget · for a real Lanna feel, pick Baan Boo Loo Village, teak houses scoring 9.6 · for a luxurious stay next to a temple, pick Chala Number 6 · for a low-thousand-baht budget with a pool, pick My Chiangmai Boutique Lodge · on a few-hundred-baht budget, pick Green Sleep Hostel ฿300 or Stamps Backpackers ฿450 · every one is within walking distance of the temples and the Sunday Walking Street, so compare 3 sites before booking.
